title: Clerk header
description: An optional black announcement strip, then a floating, rounded 42px bar that sticks 8px from the top: logo, a hairline divider, small nav links with chevrons, and 'sign in | sign up' at the right. Frosted near-white with a hairline-and-soft-shadow outline; it turns dark by itself while it floats over a dark section. On phones a two-line menu button opens the links inside the bar.
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page so it sticks for the whole scroll
surface paints the strip behind the bar's resting place (card for a white hero, background otherwise)
the chevrons are decoration, not dropdowns
name: clerk-header
